messages:
lucy: Heads-up — customer Helix flagged an odd charge: they were billed full reserved commit plus a prorate for the same seats in April. Can billing ops look?
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-201 generated for account helix-labs. Total $8,120. PDF: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-201 (auto-note)
ben: Can you paste the three invoice lines?
lucy: snippet:
```
LineItem: RESERVED_COMMIT   Period: 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30  Amount: $5,000  CommitID: rwd-commit-99
LineItem: RESERVED_COMMIT_PRORATE  Period: 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-10  Amount: $1,800
LineItem: OVERAGE_BURST  Period: 2026-04-11 to 2026-04-30  Amount: $1,320
```
That prorate shouldn't exist because commit change happened before invoice job ran.
karen: Looking at billing logs: proration job retried after a timeout and reinserted a prorate row even though a full commit line already existed. The proration path lacks an idempotency key and also doesn't check for overlapping reserved_commit lines.
ben: Short fix: create credit CM-2026-0210 for $1,800 and update invoice. Long fix: add idempotency token and overlap-suppress in proration; also add a post-run validation to ensure reserved sums match expected commit seats.
finance-lead: Approve credit up to $2k — go ahead and post CM. Please document in BLG-3410 and include impact assessment.
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-0210 for $1,800 created (pending-post). Requires ticket BLG-3410.
lucy: Ticket BLG-3410 created for reconciliation and root-cause.
billing-bot: CM-2026-0210 posted. Invoice updated to INV-2026-201-v2. PDF: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-201-v2
ben: I ran a quick query for commit_change_date between 2026-04-01 and 2026-04-30 and found 6 accounts with commit changes that month. I'll dump candidates to BLG-3410 for manual review.
karen: Also check SLA credit calc for those six — ensure no duplicate outage events were fed in the same retry window. We had a replay issue last month.
finance-lead: Thanks. Please include the list and ETA for the proration fix in the BLG ticket. We'll loop in account reps before customers get notified.
lucy: Noted. Moving to close here once BLG-3410 has the postmortem and the credit has posted.
